**Software Engineer**
*This is a Hybrid position working from our Legacy West Support Center located in Plano Texas.*
“The Company does not provide visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S.”
  
  
**About Sally Beauty Holdings, Inc.**
At SBH, our purpose is to inspire a more colorful, confident, and welcoming world. We are the leader in professional hair color, selling and distributing professional beauty supplies across 11 countries through our Sally Beauty and Beauty Systems Group businesses. Sally Beauty offers products for hair color, hair care, nails, and skin care to retail customers looking for salon quality products at a value price. Beauty Systems Group, branded as Cosmo Prof or Armstrong McCall stores, along with its direct sales consultants, sell professionally branded products intended for use and resale by salons to retail consumers.
  
  
**About The Role**
Design, program, build and deploy software applications in cloud technologies like Mulesoft, Azure Data Factory etc. Perform impact analysis and modify existing software programs for enhancements and bug fixes. Participate in agile development process including requirements gathering and design. Work as an individual contributor in developing and supporting integration programs
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* 60% Writes new code or modifies existing code to meet requirements of company business applications. Tests or Debugs his/her work to ensure that the functional requirements are met and that completed work is of high quality. Follows company development standards specific to the team.
* 25% Provides production support in the form of troubleshooting problems, break fixes.
* 10% Responsible for unit testing their codes, involve in code review process and document their development work. Individuals should be able to collaborate with the team and proactively work with the Dev Lead and Architect to identify areas for optimization.
* 5% Complies with existing documentation requirements required for the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Complies with Payment Card Industry (PCI) requirements as required.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, with strong exposure to cloud and scripting technologies such as Azure, AWS, Python, JavaScript, and Node.js.
* Strong knowledge of server-side programming languages such as Java and C#.
* Proven ability to work independently and deliver consistent results with minimal supervision.
* Strong conceptual, analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, troubleshooting, and resolution skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Working Conditions & Physical Requirements**
The work environment involves everyday risks or discomforts which require normal safety precautions typical of such places as offices, meeting and training rooms, retail stores, and residences or commercial vehicles, e.g., use of safe work practices with office equipment, avoidance of trips and falls, observance of fire regulations and traffic signals, etc. The work area is adequately lighted, heated, and ventilated.
  
  
The work is sedentary. Typically, the employee may sit comfortably to do the work. However, there may be some walking; standing; bending; carrying of light items such as papers, files, books, small parts; using a keyboard, driving an automobile, etc. No special physical demands are required to perform the work.
  
  
**Benefits**
We offer a competitive salary and outstanding benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life Insurance, paid vacation and sick days, paid holidays, tuition reimbursement and 401(k) with company match. In addition, associates of SBH may take advantage of our in house salon with complementary services and a varied selection of food options at our corporate campus. Also, featured at our corporate campus, is both a Sally Beauty and CosmoProf Professional onsite store, where associates enjoy a great merchandise discount!

SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER in TEST
Contract role, 12 months
Hybrid status
Location: Aliso Viejo, San Mateo or San Diego
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test to join our System Integration Team at Sony Interactive Entertainment. In this role, you will support quality engineering for customer-facing applications in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, helping ensure that new and existing features meet a high bar for reliability, usability, and overall player experience.
Responsibilities
Review product requirements and design documents to create effective testing strategies
Build concrete test plans, write test cases and execute them to ensure quality of features
Implement and maintain test automation scripts to increase test coverage and stability
Develop, maintain and improve test automation framework
Report, track and verify defects as well as monitor Automation jobs
Provide status reports to Leadership and other key partners
Work with the infrastructure team to maintain common services such as CI test pipelines
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or ability to demonstrate equivalent knowledge
3+ years experience in UI automation for web or native applications
Validated experience in Software testing life cycle
Experience with version control solutions (both centralized and distributed)
Experience maintaining CI systems (Jenkins preferred)
Experience with Selenium or Appium
Experience in one or more Programming/Scripting Languages, preferably Python.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with at least one modern web application framework such as Angular/Ember.js/React
Experience developing or testing a non-PC device (phone/game console/set-top box, etc.)
Experience with Agile methodologies
Significant experience with Python
Experience with Node.js, React Native
Experience developing or writing test code for a game console
About You
You have a strong drive and passion for quality and can help inspire, motivate, and influence team members toward better engineering outcomes.
You communicate clearly and professionally with partners at all levels, including technical teams, product stakeholders, and project leads.
You are effective at working with geographically distributed and culturally diverse teams.
You are curious, proactive, and willing to go beyond immediate assignments to deeply understand the systems you support.
You are comfortable asking questions, identifying risks early, and helping the team make informed quality and release decisions.

**Description**
At Amazon, our tech isn't just a tool, it's your playground. Our engineers work on scalable systems, cloud services, and customer-facing products that operate at global scale. This is an environment where you learn by building. Whether you're creating cloud-native solutions, optimizing machine learning models, or building products that drive experiences for millions of customers around the globe, your work reaches the world, fast. You'll take ownership early, collaborate across teams and disciplines, and grow your skills as you tackle new problems. There's no single path forward here, with a chance to explore different directions and shape your journey as you go. This is where ambition meets opportunity and, where the impact of what you build helps define what comes next, for customers and for you.
  
  
What's in it for you? An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You'll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.
  
  
**About The Team**
Annapurna Labs designs the custom silicon at Amazon - including Graviton (our server processors), Trainium and Inferentia (our machine learning training and inference accelerators), and the Nitro system that powers modern EC2. We own the full stack, from silicon through the software that makes it work (compilers, runtimes, drivers, and the frameworks that let customers run workloads on our hardware). As a Software Development Engineer Intern, you'll write the software that turns custom silicon into products used by millions.
  
  
**Where You Might Land**
Annapurna has software teams spanning the full stack, and we work to place you on a technical team aligned with your interests and strengths. Example teams and focus areas include:
  
  

* Compiler development for ML accelerators (Neuron SDK, MLIR, LLVM)
* ML runtimes and frameworks (integration with PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow)
* Low-level systems software, firmware, and device drivers
* Performance optimization and kernel development for custom silicon
* Distributed training and inference infrastructure

Once you join, we partner with you and our hiring managers to match you to a team where your background and interests fit best, so your project is something you're genuinely excited to work on.
  
  
As an SDE Intern, you'll contribute to real production software, which may include:
  
  

* Designing, implementing, and testing software across the stack - from low-level systems code to compilers, runtimes, and tooling
* Writing efficient, maintainable code in languages such as C, C++, or Python
* Optimizing software performance on custom hardware (Graviton, Trainium, Inferentia)
* Debugging complex issues across the hardware-software boundary
* Collaborating with hardware, compiler, and systems teams to deliver features end-to-end
* Documenting your work and presenting results to the team

You'll be paired with a mentor and manager who will scope your project, support your growth, and set you up to deliver meaningful, measurable impact by the end of your internship.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree program in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with a final graduation date of December 2027 or later
* Programming experience in at least one modern language such as C, C++, Java, or Python
* Coursework or project experience in data structures, algorithms, and software design
* Understanding of core computer science fundamentals: operating systems, computer architecture, or systems programming

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in a Linux/Unix environment
* Experience working with fast-moving, high-performance teams and driving innovative solutions tailored to unique business environments
* Can show strong verbal and written communication skills
* Pursuing a degree with a focus on systems, compilers, computer architecture, or high-performance computing
* Experience with low-level or systems programming in C/C++ (memory management, concurrency, performance optimization)
* Familiarity with compilers (MLIR, LLVM, TVM), ML runtimes, operating systems internals, or distributed systems
* Exposure to machine learning frameworks and an understanding of how models run on hardware
* Prior internship, research, or open-source contribution experience in systems, compilers, or ML infrastructure

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.
  
  
Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation.
